title: Lifting a finite etale splitting across fully faithful base change
statement: Let B,W,E,F be schemes, z:W→B, p:E→B and r:F→B finite etale morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose either z is an isomorphism, or the actual finite-etale pullback functor along z induces a bijection on every morphism set. Given an isomorphism e0:E×_B W≅F×_B W whose hom followed by the W-projection equals the W-projection on E×_B W, there is e:E≅F with e.hom followed by r equal to p.

source.place: Tag 0EY9, categorical assembly of full faithfulness as used in Tag 0EYJ; Mathlib CategoryTheory/Functor/FullyFaithful.lean and the actual FiniteEtale.pullback functor.

proof.text: If z is an isomorphism, the first projections a:E×_B W→E and b:F×_B W→F are isomorphisms. Set e=a inverse followed by e0 followed by b. The pullback equations and the equation for e0 show e.hom followed by r equals p.

Otherwise make p and r objects P,Q of FiniteEtale B. The equation for e0 and its inverse makes their hom and inv morphisms f0,g0 between the pullback objects. Surjectivity lifts them to f:P→Q and g:Q→P. Functor.map_comp, map_id and the two inverse identities of e0 imply that f followed by g and g followed by f map to identities. Injectivity makes both composites identities. Extract the underlying scheme maps to build e; FiniteEtale.hom_left_comp gives its equation over B.

lean.statement:
theorem powerSeries_punctured_split_assembly
    {B W E F : Scheme.{u}} (z : W ⟶ B) (p : E ⟶ B) (r : F ⟶ B)
    [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [IsFinite r] [Etale r]
    (hfull : IsIso z ∨ ∀ P Q : B.FiniteEtale,
      Function.Bijective ((FiniteEtale.pullback z).map (X := P) (Y := Q)))
    (e₀ : pullback p z ≅ pullback r z)
    (he₀ : e₀.hom ≫ pullback.snd r z = pullback.snd p z) :
    ∃ e : E ≅ F, e.hom ≫ r = p
